meta.name: mini_refseq
meta.index: build/mini_refseq: 42 RefSeq records in 9 taxid columns, k=31 basic, row_diff_brwt_coord with headers (.seqs) and an index manifest (scripts/traversal/build_mini_refseq.sh)
meta.server_hint: a local server_query on build/mini_refseq, e.g. --port 5871 --traverse-max-seeds 4 --traverse-max-time-ms 5000
notes: for validating bench_traverse.py and for before/after RESULT checks on a deterministic index; classes are nominal (the index has 42 records), timings are not representative
headers/columns = the mini records that carry the offset-0 window exactly, and their columns

mini_sparse.notes: P. aeruginosa chromosome window (column 287) (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_ndm1.notes: blaNDM-1 [300,360) on pNDM_18ES (as ndm1_amr) (25 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_poxa48.notes: pOXA-48 repA window (as poxa48_repA) (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_kpc.notes: blaKPC-2 window on pKpQIL (as kpc_amr) (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_23S.notes: the ec_23S_dV window in a P. aeruginosa 23S (multi-copy rrn) (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_ecoli.notes: E. coli plasmid window (column 562) (5 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_fresh_23S.notes: 23S window 2,140 bp upstream of mini_23S (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_fresh_named.notes: P. aeruginosa chromosome window (1 mini records carry the window exactly)

mini_fresh_lookahead.notes: plasmid window (column 615) (2 mini records carry the window exactly)
